meta.scope: 仅智慧芽原生 MCP/API；第三方数据源封装不纳入。
meta.tier_model: 每能力域一根主干(trunk)，其余为该域分支(branch)。5 主干：core-patents / pharma-intelligence / company-profile / materials-search-mcp / patsnap-search
known_gaps: 官方 MCP 详情页只提供 tool 的入参 schema，不提供返回字段；tools[].data_fields 暂为空，字段级信息见 apis[].response_fields。因此无法用「响应参数」反推 MCP↔API 对应关系。
AI 工作流类 tool 重写入参（task_id/data/execution）并串行调用多个 API，静态 schema 无法还原调用链；这类工具的映射需维护者实测补充，见 tools[].mapping_status = opaque_workflow 与 docs/api-mapping-review.md。
20 个 API 编号对应新旧两版 path，编号本身不唯一；涉及条目以 tools[].api_link.ambiguous_code 标记并附全部 path。
exclusive（API-only / MCP-only 实测结论）按维护者要求保持为空，逐个补充。
场景的 API 组合建议不完整：scenario_bundles[].api_codes 只来自已建立的 MCP→API 映射；exclusive 为空，因此「哪些数据只能 API 获取、需额外申请 API Key」尚缺实测结论。

change_log.note: 新增起步包与场景推荐层：按用户身份分 5 个包（最小/标准两档）、36 条场景覆盖全部 50 个 MCP、上下文成本由 tool schema 自动估算、场景 API 编号由 204 条映射反查；新增 getting-started.md 与 AI 入口 llms.txt / AGENTS.md。

recommendation_model.starter_kit_dimension: 按用户身份/领域划分，不按能力域主干；每个包分 minimal / standard 两档
recommendation_model.why_not_trunks: 5 根主干合计约 35,645 token，其中 pharma-intelligence 单个约 26,955 token；只做单一领域的用户装全部主干会白白占用大量上下文。
recommendation_model.context_estimate: mcps[].context_cost.est_tokens = 工具名+能力描述+input_schema JSON 的字符数 / 3.2 粗估，仅用于相对比较与最小上下文择优，不是精确 tokenizer 结果，不可用于计费核算。
recommendation_model.api_codes_source: 由 tools[].api_ref 反查并校验官方有效编号，不再手写；见 data/api-mapping.json
recommendation_model.api_only_gap: 待维护者补充：本场景的 api_codes 仅来自已建立的 MCP→API 映射；「哪些数据只能走 API、需额外申请 API Key」尚缺实测结论（exclusive 为空），因此 API 组合建议不完整。
recommendation_model.curated_input: data/recommendations.json（人工判断，自动刷新不覆盖）

tools.name: fetch_document_material_evidence
tools.capability:
从指定专利提取详细材料证据，用于现有技术检索、FTO 评估或材料比较中的成分、性能及来源核对；本工具本身不提供法律分析或权利要求解释。

输入 documents 为 1～10 个专利标识对象，每项包含 id 和 id_type；id_type 为 patent_number（专利编号）或 patent_id（PatSnap 内部专利 UUID）。已知专利标识时可以直接调用，无需先搜索；不支持论文或 DOI。

输出包含 data.results[].materials_data、warnings 和 cost_estimate。记录通过 entity_type 区分：alloy_composition 在 substance_composition 中返回元素成分范围；substance_property 返回 property_id、property_name、measurement 和 unit。另一记录类型专属的字段不返回，可空字段可能为 null。

合金元素使用数值 min/max。性能观测保留原始 measurement.value_str 和原始 unit；min/max 为 null 不代表没有性能值。原始性能单位不一定是搜索使用的标准单位，不应直接混用。

可用来源位于各材料记录中，顶层 evidence 数组目前始终为空。合金记录的 source_section/source_text 可为 null；性能记录的 source_sections 与 source_text 数组分别独立去重并保留稳定顺序，不可按下标配对。章节和原文片段可能各自缺失；存在性能值不保证具有可核验的原文。引用证据前必须检查来源字段和 warnings，缺失信息应明确标注，不得编造。
tools.description_en:
Fetch compositions, properties, and available provenance for 1–10 known patents
by patent_id or patent_number.

- Material records and provenance are in data.results[].materials_data.
- Property measurements retain raw value_str and unit: null min/max does not
  mean no measurement. Raw units may differ from standard search units.
- Property source_sections and source_text are independently deduplicated;
  never pair them by index. Excerpts may be missing even when values exist.
- Check warnings and record-level sources before citing evidence; successful
  responses may contain partial results. This tool does not interpret claims.

tools.name: search_material_evidence
tools.capability:
根据归一化的材料实体及文档级交集检索材料专利。支持合金成分、物质名称和性能名称，尽可能解析为规范的 substance_id/property_id 后检索。

必须同时提供 query 和 search。query 至少包含一个条件，最多包含 10 个物质/性能条件及 1 个合金成分条件。合金元素使用 chemical_symbol、min、max，composition_unit 为 wt（重量百分比）或 at（原子百分比）。search 至少提供完整自然语言 semantic_query、非空 keywords 或支持的结构化 filters 之一。关键词应为独立技术词，建议 3～8 个，不应将完整句子作为单个关键词。search_strategy 和 domain_filters 由工具生成，调用方不得传入。

物质条件之间为或关系（contains_any），性能条件之间也为或关系；物质组与性能组在文档级取交集，不保证条件对应同一材料记录。不支持同一材料绑定、contains_all 或 contains_none。范围比较可能命中与查询区间重叠的已存储区间，不保证整个区间都位于查询范围内。

性能查询可省略 measurement 或设为 null，此时仅按性能 ID 检索，不限制单位。提供 measurement 时，必须设置 measurement.unit，且须与 DaaS 返回的标准单位完全一致；eq/ne/gt/gte/lt/lte 数值比较符均为可选，仅提供单位时按性能和单位过滤。不得在 measurement 同级放置 unit，即使为 null 或重复值也会被拒绝。工具不自动换算单位；单位不匹配时返回 INVALID_INPUT 并提示标准单位，重试前必须正确换算数值，不能只替换单位名称。标准单位不可用时应说明数值条件无法执行，不得静默删除条件。

返回 data.docs 候选专利，以及 status、hints、data.total_hits、returned_count、error 和 cost_estimate。每条候选包含 patent_id、patent_number、title、abstract（最多 200 字符，可为 null）、view_url、jurisdiction、assignees、publication_date 和 legal_status。候选并非详细材料证据；应使用返回的真实 patent_id 调用 fetch_document_material_evidence，documents=[{"id":"实际返回的 patent_id","id_type":"patent_id"}]，进一步核对材料记录及来源。保留原始 view_url；不保证未登录用户可访问。

即使检索成功也必须检查 hints：部分条件无法归一化时，仅成功解析的条件进入材料筛选，不得声称所有原始条件都已满足。全部无法归一化时返回 NOT_NORMALIZED；缺失摘要时 abstract 为 null 并附提示；下游搜索失败返回 SEARCH_FAILED，包含 error.message 和修正提示；无结果返回 NO_RESULTS。

limit 为 1～50，offset + limit 不得超过 1000。排序字段前的负号表示降序，例如 -publication。搜索成功计费 20 积分，未成功检索不计费。

本工具不用于已知专利的完整材料数据提取（应使用 fetch_document_material_evidence），也不用于自由文本抽取。
tools.description_en:
Search material patents by resolving structured substance, property, or alloy queries.

- Strict AND across resolved substances, property conditions, standard filters,
  and values within each standard filter. Matches are document-level, not
  necessarily the same material; each property's constraints match one record.
- Unresolved items are dropped: inspect hints even on success. None resolved:
  NOT_NORMALIZED. Never claim dropped criteria were satisfied.
- measurement.unit must exactly match the standard unit. No automatic conversion;
  convert numeric values too when retrying. Never silently drop constraints.
  Ranges match overlapping stored intervals, not full containment.
- Results are candidates: use returned patent_id with
  fetch_document_material_evidence before claiming material evidence.
- query: at most 10 substance/property items plus one alloy item.
- search must include at least one of: a non-empty semantic_query, a
  non-empty keywords list, or non-empty filters. Multiple fields may be
  supplied together; all non-empty fields are sent to the search backend.
  Pagination alone is invalid.
- Pagination parameters are `search.limit` and `search.offset`,
  expressed as integers; never provide them at the tool's top level.
  search.limit must be an integer from 1 to 50; search.offset must be a
  non-negative integer, and offset + limit must not exceed 1000. Example:
  `{"search": {"keywords": ["aluminum"], "limit": 5, "offset": 5}}`.

mcps.summary_en: PatSnap Company Intelligence MCP provides company entity search and screening, innovation overviews, company competitiveness analysis, technology and innovation capability assessment, technology risk identification, and assessment report generation for AI agents, developers, and business systems. It supports identifying a company by company name, platform company ID, Unified Social Credit Code, or Organization Code, and screening companies by location, industry, registration information, innovation ratings, financing stage, and patent criteria. Results cover innovation trends over the past ten years, R&D stability, technology portfolio, technology quality, technology impact, and patent-related risks. Outputs support company innovation research and technology due diligence and do not constitute legal, investment, credit, funding, partnership, or procurement advice.

mcps.summary: 专利自由实施（FTO）风险分析服务。输入一段技术方案，即可完成专利检索、风险专利筛查、权利要求逐项比对，并产出可交付的 Word 分析报告。方案润色、特征提取、关键词扩展、检索式生成与优化、专利初筛、Claim Chart 比对、报告导出均为独立步骤，供 Agent 按需组合。检索范围可按国家/地区、申请日、法律状态、权利人限定。
mcps.summary_en: Freedom-to-operate (FTO) patent risk analysis. Give it a technical solution and it searches patents, screens out the ones that matter, compares them claim by claim, and produces a deliverable Word report. Each stage is a separate step an agent can combine as needed: proposal polishing, feature extraction, keyword expansion, query generation and tuning, patent screening, Claim Chart comparison, and report export. Searches can be limited by country, application date, legal status, and assignee.

tools.name: fto_cc_analysis
tools.capability: 对筛选出的专利做 Claim Chart 逐项比对，判定侵权风险等级。单次最多 10 篇，返回高风险专利的详细比对内容；高、中、低风险的完整结果都会保存，专利较多时可复用同一任务分批分析。
tools.description_en: Runs a claim-by-claim (Claim Chart) comparison on shortlisted patents and rates the infringement risk. Up to 10 patents per call, returning detailed comparisons for the high-risk ones; complete high, medium, and low results are all saved, so larger sets can be analyzed in batches under the same task.

tools.name: standard_claim_charting
tools.capability: 提供 3GPP TS/TR、ITU（含音视频）和 IEEE WiFi 的 SEP 技术对标。PN 必填；自动推荐、section 召回、AICC 端到端分析，或从指定标准/section 开始。默认 3gpp，由下游决定 CC 执行方式。 standards 跳过推荐；旧 TS 仅用于 3gpp且不与非空 standards 同传；section_id 优先并跳过推荐/召回，仍校验 TS 冲突和类型。claim_num 为实际 claim 编号而非独权序号；lang 按上下文显式传入。结果需专家复核。
tools.description_en: SEP technical claim charting for 3GPP TS/TR, ITU (including audio/video), and IEEE WiFi. PN is required. Recommend standards, recall sections, and run end-to-end AICC, or start from specified standards/sections. Defaults to 3gpp; downstream defaults determine CC execution. standards skips recommendation; legacy TS is 3gpp-only and cannot coexist with nonempty standards. section_id takes priority and skips recommendation/recall, but TS conflict/type checks still apply. claim_num is the actual claim number, not the Nth independent claim. Pass lang explicitly from context. Results require expert review.

mcps.display_name: 智慧芽专利检索与报告
mcps.summary:
面向知识产权检索与分析场景的 MCP 服务，统一提供查新检索、发明 FTO 分析和外观设计 FTO 分析能力。
查新检索：根据技术方案、发明交底书或权利要求文本执行查新检索，并返回摘要、特征提取、候选专利、对比和报告等步骤结果。
发明 FTO 分析：针对产品或技术实现描述进行自由实施风险分析，支持国家、申请日、法律状态、权利人等过滤条件。
外观设计 FTO：基于单张产品或外观设计图片执行外观风险检索与分析。
mcps.summary_en:
An MCP service for intellectual property search and analysis, providing unified novelty search, invention FTO analysis, and design FTO analysis.
Novelty search: Performs novelty searches based on technical solutions, invention disclosures, or claim text, and returns step results including summaries, feature extraction, candidate patents, comparisons, and reports.
Invention FTO analysis: Assesses freedom-to-operate risk for product or technical implementation descriptions, with filters such as country, application date, legal status, and assignee.
Design FTO: Performs design risk search and analysis based on a single product or design image.

mcps.summary: 面向研发难题攻关与产品降本的 TRIZ 概念方案生成 MCP。系统根据任务目标进入创新攻关或研发降本工作流：前者通过问题分析、案例匹配与 TRIZ 方法生成创新概念方案；后者基于产品结构、功能和成本信息，运用 TRIZ／DFMA 诊断与裁剪生成降本方案及收益测算。支持任务进度跟踪、候选方案获取和方案详情查询，帮助企业 Agent 高效产出可评估的概念方案。单次完整方案生成通常需要约 5–10 分钟，实际耗时可能因任务复杂度、输入信息完整度及系统负载有所浮动，请预留相应处理时间。
mcps.summary_en: A TRIZ concept-solution generation MCP for tackling complex R&D challenges and reducing product costs. Based on the task objective, the system enters either an innovation problem-solving workflow or an R&D cost-reduction workflow: the former generates innovative concept solutions through problem analysis, case matching, and TRIZ methods; the latter uses product structure, function, and cost information, together with TRIZ/DFMA diagnosis and trimming, to generate cost-reduction solutions and benefit estimates. It supports task progress tracking, candidate solution retrieval, and solution detail queries, helping enterprise agents efficiently produce concept solutions that can be evaluated. A complete solution generation run typically takes about 5–10 minutes. Actual processing time may vary depending on task complexity, the completeness of the input information, and system load. Please allow sufficient time for processing.

One call accepts at most 100 section ID input values and deduplicates repeats. This is an input limit and does not cap the number of sections returned by number plus version. Set source to 3gpp, itu, ieee, or wifi; both ieee and wifi select IEEE (Wi-Fi).

mcps.summary: 将研发技术提案转化为专利申请决策依据。面向企业研发、知识产权及创新管理团队，查新检索通过模型上下文协议（MCP），向 AI 应用和智能代理提供智慧芽新颖性检索工具及工作流能力，帮助企业在投入专利申请前，快速评估技术方案的创新价值与申请潜力。用户无需掌握专利数据库字段、分类号或复杂的检索语法，也无需人工拆解技术方案、反复调整检索式。只需提供研发技术提案、发明交底材料或相关技术文档，AI 应用和智能代理即可调用标准化工具，完成技术方案理解、关键技术特征提取、检索要素生成、专利及科技文献检索、现有技术对比，以及新颖性与创造性初步分析。查新结果可帮助团队识别潜在的现有技术风险，初步判断技术方案的专利申请价值，并为权利要求设计和专利申请策略提供决策参考。
mcps.summary_en: Turn R&D Proposals into Patent Filing Insights. Novelty Search uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to make Patsnap’s novelty search tools and workflow available to MCP-enabled AI applications and agents. Designed for R&D, intellectual property, and innovation management teams, it helps organizations assess the innovative value and patent potential of new technologies, product improvements, and technical solutions before investing in a patent application. Users do not need to understand patent database fields, classification systems, Boolean syntax, or complex search strategies. They simply provide an R&D proposal, invention disclosure, technical description, or supporting document. The AI application or agent can then invoke standardized tools to understand the proposed solution, extract key technical features, generate search elements, retrieve relevant patents and scientific and technical literature, compare the most relevant prior art, and perform an initial novelty and inventive-step assessment. The resulting insights help teams identify potential prior-art risks, evaluate whether an invention is worth pursuing for patent protection, and make better-informed decisions about claim drafting and patent filing strategy.

必须使用自然语言，而不是关键词列表，例如 ✅“治疗青光眼的药物技术方案”，❌“青光眼 治疗 药物”。
适用于概念或机理探索。方法名、缩写或研究主题术语使用 keywords；作者、机构、日期或被引次数约束使用 filters。

input_fields.name: offset
input_fields.description:
分页偏移量，表示跳过前多少条结果，默认值为 0。
约束：`offset + limit ≤ 1000`。

input_fields.name: keywords
input_fields.description:
用于匹配标题、摘要和全文的 BM25 关键词列表，建议 3–8 个。仅当 'keyword' ∈ search_strategy 时必填。
每一项必须是一个原子化技术术语、方法、材料、缩写、数据集或研究概念。去除“技术”“方法”“研究”等宽泛词；可增加中英文或缩写与全称变体以提高召回率，例如 ['基因编辑','gene editing']。不得传入句子或逗号拼接的字符串，避免超过 15 个术语。

input_fields.name: search_strategy
input_fields.description:
检索策略，可从 'semantic'、'keyword'、'filter' 中选择 1–3 个。根据请求类型选择：
- 自然语言研究问题或机理 → ['semantic'] + semantic_query
- 具体术语、方法、材料或数据集 → ['keyword'] + keywords
- 纯作者、机构或日期范围 → ['filter'] + filters
- 主题术语 + 结构化论文约束 → ['keyword','filter']，主题术语放入 keywords，约束放入 filters
- 自然语言研究问题 + 结构化论文约束 → ['semantic','filter']，问题或概念放入 semantic_query，约束放入 filters。

input_fields.name: limit
input_fields.description:
单页返回结果数量，范围为 1–100，默认值为 10。
与 `offset` 配合进行分页；约束：`offset + limit ≤ 1000`。

input_fields.name: sort
input_fields.description:
结果排序方式。'relevance'（默认）表示最佳匹配优先；其他值按对应属性排序，'-' 前缀表示降序。
字段：publication、cited_count。
仅当用户明确要求按时间或影响力排序（例如“最新”“被引最多”）时使用字段排序。

tools.name: search_patent
tools.capability:
检索全球专利，支持语义、关键词、结构化过滤和 PatSnap 布尔检索，返回按相关性或指定字段排序的分页结果与元数据。collapse_family 默认为 false，设为 true 时每个专利同族返回一条结果；Boolean 检索支持全部列出的排序选项。

## 必须遵守的约束
- 关键词保留完整核心技术概念及必要限定。未指定目标语言时，为每个概念提供含义一致的中英日词组；遵循用户明确的关键词或语言限制。
tools.description_en:
Search global patents using semantic search, keywords, structured filters, or PatSnap Boolean queries; return paginated results and metadata sorted by relevance or a specified field. Set collapse_family=true to return one result per patent family; the default is false. Boolean retrieval supports all listed sort options.

## Invariants (MUST obey)
- Keywords preserve complete concepts and target-language coverage. Keep each core technical concept and its defining qualifiers together. When target languages are unspecified, provide equivalent Chinese, English, and Japanese phrases for each concept; respect explicit keyword or language restrictions.

input_fields.name: semantic_query
input_fields.description: 用自然语言忠实表达完整技术意图，保留用户指定的对象、用途、机制或性能，不额外限定应用范围或技术路线。申请人、发明人、日期、受理局、IPC 或法律状态约束放入 filters。仅在选择 semantic 时提供，且必须提供。

input_fields.name: offset
input_fields.description:
分页偏移量，表示跳过前多少条结果，默认值为 0。
约束：`offset + limit ≤ 1000`。

input_fields.name: keywords
input_fields.description:
用于标题、摘要、权利要求或说明书匹配的核心技术概念短语。每项保留完整概念及必要限定，不拆成可独立召回的泛词。每项关键词可独立召回，semantic_query 不会约束关键词命中范围。
未指定目标语言时，为每个核心概念提供含义一致的中英日词组；指定时使用所要求的受支持语言。仅支持中英日文本，系统不自动翻译；其他语言使用 semantic。保持列表精简，遵守用户明确的关键词限制。仅在选择 keyword 时提供，且必须提供。

input_fields.name: search_strategy
input_fields.description:
根据检索意图选择策略：
- 有核心术语的技术主题 → 优先 ['semantic','keyword']：semantic_query 表达完整意图，keywords 提供核心概念词组。
- 没有可用核心术语的概念问题，或检索关键词不支持的语言 → ['semantic']。
- 明确要求仅关键词或术语查找 → ['keyword']。
- 结构化约束 → 增加 filter；仅查元数据 → ['filter']。
- 可执行 PatSnap 字段检索式、明确要求 Boolean 检索，或过滤条件无法表达的字段级分组 → 独占使用 ['boolean']。
严格绑定：选择某个策略时必须提供对应参数，未选择时禁止提供——semantic↔semantic_query、keyword↔keywords、filter↔filters/domain_filters（至少设置一个字段）、boolean↔boolean_query。选择 boolean 时，search_strategy 必须恰好为 ['boolean']；不得提供 semantic_query、keywords、filters、domain_filters 或非 general 的 domain。默认值为 ['keyword']。

input_fields.name: collapse_family
input_fields.description: 是否按专利同族折叠结果，默认 false，逐篇返回。设为 true 时每个同族返回一条结果，data.total_hits 按同族计数；适用于 semantic、keyword、filter 及独占的 boolean 策略。非 Boolean 检索的同族总数为估算值，缺失同族标识的专利逐篇计数。

input_fields.name: domain_filters
input_fields.description: 专业领域约束采用字段优先、与类型无关的伪 JSON 模板：{"<field>":{"<operator>":<符合 Schema 和 value_shape 的 operand>}}。尖括号中的元变量仅用于说明，绝不能原样发送。构造本字段前必须调用 describe_search_capability。本字段仅适用于受支持的专业领域。字段或属性的 operators 数组是允许使用的操作符清单；只能使用所选能力中定义的字段名、属性名、操作符、Schema 和原始值示例。基本类型集合的操作数是字面量数组；对象集合的操作数是非空 Object Filter 数组，每个属性条件都是形如 {"eq":value} 的 Operator Object。不同字段之间、同一字段的多个操作符之间，以及同一 Object Filter 内的属性条件之间均为 AND；同一 Object Filter 内的属性必须匹配同一个集合元素。每个 Object Filter 至少需要一个不是 ne/not_in 的条件。所有字段、属性、操作符和操作数都必须符合所选能力；能力中未声明的名称或操作数无效。每个数组操作数最多接受 100 个不同元素。当 domain='general' 或 search_strategy 不包含 'filter' 时，本字段无效。

input_fields.name: domain
input_fields.description:
检索能力选择器。常规专利元数据检索使用 'general'；当请求的概念、约束或返回字段超出常规专利元数据时，才使用本 Schema 中列出的专业领域能力。应根据语义范围选择，而不是根据值的表示形式选择。

可选值：
- general：通用专利检索能力。
- ls：当用户检索涉及药物、治疗靶点、疾病、专利类别、技术、化学结构或生物序列的生命科学专利时使用。实体过滤器接受公开名称。

input_fields.name: limit
input_fields.description:
单页返回结果数量，范围为 1–100，默认值为 10。
与 `offset` 配合进行分页；约束：`offset + limit ≤ 1000`。

input_fields.name: sort
input_fields.description: 结果排序方式。用户未要求特定顺序时，使用 relevance 按最佳匹配排序；仅在用户明确要求按时间或被引次数/影响力排序时使用对应属性排序。字段：publication、application、granted、expired、priority、cited_count；不带前缀为升序，'-' 前缀为降序。所有排序选项均适用于 Boolean 检索；Boolean 检索的 priority 按最早优先权日排序。

input_fields.name: filters
input_fields.description: 专利过滤条件。必须传入 JSON 对象，不得传入字符串化的 JSON。只设置用户明确给出的字段，不得推断或猜测。仅接受下列字段，未知字段会被拒绝。

input_fields.name: boolean_query
input_fields.description: 接受两种形式：（1）按照下列语法和字段说明构造的可直接执行的 PatSnap 字段检索式；（2）完整、精确且不透明的预生成引用。可依据本字段说明直接构造检索式；用户已提供可执行检索式时必须原样保留。预生成引用必须保持完整且原样使用，不得由其他值推导，不得与检索语法组合，也不得解析、展开或改写。引用格式：BOOLEAN_QUERY_ID:bq_<64 位小写十六进制字符>。Boolean 字段、含义和示例：使用用户明确提供的技术主题、关键词、短语、缩写、产品名、材料名或工艺词，并选择能够覆盖所需文档部分的最窄技术文本字段。同一技术字段中的每个备选项都必须能够独立、完整地表达用户要求的技术概念并保留必要上下文；多词概念应保留为带引号的完整短语，避免孤立的歧义缩写或宽泛组成词。TTL_ALL：在标题原文和译文中匹配，例如 TTL_ALL:("solid-state battery")；TA_ALL：在标题和摘要的原文及译文中匹配，例如 TA_ALL:("fuel cell" OR "hydrogen fuel cell")；TAC_ALL：在标题、摘要和权利要求的原文及译文中匹配，例如 TAC_ALL:("wireless charging")；TACD_ALL：在标题、摘要、权利要求和说明书的原文及译文中匹配，例如 TACD_ALL:("carbon capture")。申请人和受让人约束使用以下字段：ANC 按当前权利人名称匹配，例如 ANC:("Y")；ANCS 按已解析、标准化的当前权利人名称匹配，例如 ANCS:("S")；ANCS_ID 按已解析、标准化的专利申请人 ID 匹配，该 ID 不是公司 ID，例如 ANCS_ID:("A")；ANCS:(TREE@"<标准化公司名称>") 用于用户明确要求多公司范围时，选择已确认的指定公司及其全部下属公司节点。TREE@ 使用标准化公司名称而不是 ID，并保留名称中的标点和空格。ANCS、ANCS_ID 和 TREE@ 必须使用已解析、标准化的身份值；未经解析和标准化的用户名称使用 ANC。IN：发明人，例如 IN:("Y")；IPC：分类号，例如 IPC:(H04W)；AUTHORITY：专利受理局，例如 AUTHORITY:(CN)；APD：申请日，例如 APD:[YYYYMMDD TO YYYYMMDD]；PBD：公开日，例如 PBD:[YYYYMMDD TO YYYYMMDD]；PATENT_TYPE：专利类型，A 表示发明申请、B 表示授权发明、U 表示实用新型、D 表示外观设计，例如 PATENT_TYPE:(A OR B OR U OR D)；PN：公开（公告）号，例如 PN:(N)；APNO：申请号，例如 APNO:(N)。同一字段的备选值放在该字段条件内分组，各独立条件之间使用 AND、OR 或 NOT。

boolean_query.description: 接受两种形式：（1）按照下列语法和字段说明构造的可直接执行的 PatSnap 字段检索式；（2）完整、精确且不透明的预生成引用。可依据本字段说明直接构造检索式；用户已提供可执行检索式时必须原样保留。预生成引用必须保持完整且原样使用，不得由其他值推导，不得与检索语法组合，也不得解析、展开或改写。引用格式：BOOLEAN_QUERY_ID:bq_<64 位小写十六进制字符>。Boolean 字段、含义和示例：使用用户明确提供的技术主题、关键词、短语、缩写、产品名、材料名或工艺词，并选择能够覆盖所需文档部分的最窄技术文本字段。同一技术字段中的每个备选项都必须能够独立、完整地表达用户要求的技术概念并保留必要上下文；多词概念应保留为带引号的完整短语，避免孤立的歧义缩写或宽泛组成词。TTL_ALL：在标题原文和译文中匹配，例如 TTL_ALL:("solid-state battery")；TA_ALL：在标题和摘要的原文及译文中匹配，例如 TA_ALL:("fuel cell" OR "hydrogen fuel cell")；TAC_ALL：在标题、摘要和权利要求的原文及译文中匹配，例如 TAC_ALL:("wireless charging")；TACD_ALL：在标题、摘要、权利要求和说明书的原文及译文中匹配，例如 TACD_ALL:("carbon capture")。申请人和受让人约束使用以下字段：ANC 按当前权利人名称匹配，例如 ANC:("Y")；ANCS 按已解析、标准化的当前权利人名称匹配，例如 ANCS:("S")；ANCS_ID 按已解析、标准化的专利申请人 ID 匹配，该 ID 不是公司 ID，例如 ANCS_ID:("A")；ANCS:(TREE@"<标准化公司名称>") 用于用户明确要求多公司范围时，选择已确认的指定公司及其全部下属公司节点。TREE@ 使用标准化公司名称而不是 ID，并保留名称中的标点和空格。ANCS、ANCS_ID 和 TREE@ 必须使用已解析、标准化的身份值；未经解析和标准化的用户名称使用 ANC。IN：发明人，例如 IN:("Y")；IPC：分类号，例如 IPC:(H04W)；AUTHORITY：专利受理局，例如 AUTHORITY:(CN)；APD：申请日，例如 APD:[YYYYMMDD TO YYYYMMDD]；PBD：公开日，例如 PBD:[YYYYMMDD TO YYYYMMDD]；PATENT_TYPE：专利类型，A 表示发明申请、B 表示授权发明、U 表示实用新型、D 表示外观设计，例如 PATENT_TYPE:(A OR B OR U OR D)；PN：公开（公告）号，例如 PN:(N)；APNO：申请号，例如 APNO:(N)。同一字段的备选值放在该字段条件内分组，各独立条件之间使用 AND、OR 或 NOT。

tools.name: ls_evidence_by_semantic_search
tools.capability: 按语义检索选定来源的证据。
tools.description_en:
Dispatch semantic search to the selected supported evidence source.

Paper and patent vector search remain available through their original
independent tools and are intentionally excluded from this selector.

Few-shot examples (copyable calls; source picks the index, lang is required):
    User intent: Semantically find clinical trials about immunotherapy.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_semantic_search(source="clinical_trial", query="immunotherapy trials in lung cancer", top_k=20, lang="EN")
    User intent: Semantically find guideline recommendations.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_semantic_search(source="clinical_guideline", query="first-line treatment of EGFR-mutant NSCLC", top_k=10, lang="EN")
    User intent: Semantically find epidemiology evidence about the incidence of lung cancer.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_semantic_search(source="epidemiology", query="incidence and prevalence of lung cancer", top_k=20, lang="EN")
    User intent: Semantically find FDA label evidence about indications and warnings.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_semantic_search(source="fda_label", query="pembrolizumab indications and boxed warnings", top_k=20, lang="EN")
    User intent: Semantically find financial report evidence about oncology revenue.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_semantic_search(source="financial_report", query="oncology revenue and clinical pipeline commentary", top_k=20, lang="EN")
    Note: the result carries items (full entities) or chunks (text passages) depending on the source. Paper and patent vector search use their original independent tools.

tools.name: ls_evidence_by_entity_search
tools.capability: 按实体条件检索选定来源的证据。 支持 corporate_financing 企业融资事件检索，可按融资公司、投资机构、融资类型和公告日期筛选，支持同轮共同投资。融资默认每页10条，最多100条。
tools.description_en:
Dispatch a structured evidence search to exactly one source.

Source-specific request fields are validated by the original source model
before the original search function is called.  This preserves each
legacy search contract while exposing one selector-based MCP entry point.

corporate_financing searches financing events by organizations/organization_ids
(funded companies), investors/investor_ids, funding_type_mapping_codes and
announcement dates date_from/date_to (YYYY-MM-DD). Names are resolved by the
backend; IDs match exactly without parent/subsidiary expansion. Different
fields combine with AND, including names and IDs for the same role. Values
within each field default to OR. field_options.<field>.value_operator supports
AND/OR for the four company/investor fields and funding_type_mapping_codes.
Investor AND means co-investment in the same round, allowing other investors.
Supported funding codes are RZ01-RZ41 and RZ99; examples: RZ04 Series A,
RZ07 Series B, RZ20 IPO, RZ30 Debt Financing, RZ31 Grant. Dates are inclusive.
At least one non-empty filter is required. Defaults: offset=0, limit=10;
limit must be 1-100. These pagination rules apply only to corporate_financing.

For domain-specific financing, first collect organization IDs with
ls_entity_search(entity_type="organization", org_roll_up=False, ...), paging through the results,
then pass organization_ids. If no companies match, do not run an unfiltered
financing search. Direct drug/target/disease filters are not supported here.

Financing returns total and items (one per event), sorted by announcement
date descending with missing dates last. Each event includes its full investor
list, synopsis, funded_organization, funding_type and money_raised_* fields.
organization_name contains standardized id/display_name_cn/display_name_en
when available; original_name preserves the recorded name. Amounts describe
the whole round, not individual investor contributions. Domain association
does not imply funds were earmarked for that domain or historical involvement.
Results are events, not company rankings or aggregate statistics.
Unrecognized names stop the search. Backend warnings are returned as error
with total=0 and no result list. Financing is available through this search
selector only; it is not a source for semantic search or evidence fetch.

Few-shot examples (copyable calls; evidence_type picks exactly one source and only that source's filters are accepted):
    User intent: Find Phase 3 pembrolizumab trials with a comparator and target.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_entity_search(evidence_type="clinical_trial", drug=["pembrolizumab"], control_drug=["nivolumab"], target=["PD-1"], limit=20)
    User intent: Look up a known registered study.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_entity_search(evidence_type="clinical_trial", register_number="NCT03189719", study_identifier="KEYNOTE-590", limit=20)
    User intent: Find clinical result readouts for a drug in a named study.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_entity_search(evidence_type="clinical_trial_result", drug=["pembrolizumab"], study_code="KEYNOTE-590", limit=20)
    User intent: Find news about a drug and organization in a publication window.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_entity_search(evidence_type="news", keyword=["pembrolizumab PD-1 lung cancer"], drug=["pembrolizumab"], organization=["Merck"], post_date_from="2023-01-01", post_date_to="2024-12-31", limit=20)
    User intent: Find licensing deals for a drug.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_entity_search(evidence_type="drug_deal", drug=["pembrolizumab"], deal_type=["license"], limit=20)
    User intent: Find translational medicine evidence for a target and disease.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_entity_search(evidence_type="translational_medicine", target=["KRAS"], disease=["pancreatic cancer"], limit=20)
    User intent: Find financing events for HotSpot Therapeutics.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_entity_search(evidence_type="corporate_financing", organizations=["HotSpot Therapeutics"])
    User intent: Find rounds where Atlas Venture and Sofinnova Partners co-invested, using their known organization IDs.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_entity_search(evidence_type="corporate_financing", investor_ids=["b66c2d40b253677a1bf22d3e920855a0", "84791b554594ade97700883e400462bd"], field_options={"investor_ids": {"value_operator": "AND"}})
    User intent: Find Series A financing announced in 2025.
    ✔ ls_evidence_by_entity_search(evidence_type="corporate_financing", funding_type_mapping_codes=["RZ04"], date_from="2025-01-01", date_to="2025-12-31")
    Note: a filter that belongs to another source (for example journal with evidence_type="clinical_trial") is rejected.

input_fields.name: study_first_posted_date_from
input_fields.description: Start date for the first posted date, which represents the first public registration date. Use YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: '2023-01-01'

input_fields.name: study_identifier
input_fields.description: Sponsor study code or internal study identifier. Example: 'MK-3475-01'

input_fields.name: investor_ids
input_fields.description: Investor organization IDs, matched exactly against the event's investor list. Multiple values default to OR; field_options can change this to AND.

input_fields.name: evidence_type
input_fields.description: Select exactly one structured evidence source. The selected source determines the allowed filters. Selects the variant. Accepted values: 'clinical_trial', 'clinical_trial_result', 'corporate_financing', 'drug_deal', 'news', 'translational_medicine'. 'clinical_trial' uses offset, limit, query, lang, top_k, drug, control_drug, target, drug_type, mechanism_action, disease, therapeutic_area, organization, phase, study_status, dosage_form, route_of_administration, country, register_number, study_identifier, brief_title, study_first_posted_date_from, study_first_posted_date_to, field_options; 'clinical_trial_result' uses offset, limit, drug, control_drug, target, drug_type, mechanism_action, disease, therapeutic_area, organization, phase, study_code, register_number, published_date_from, published_date_to, field_options; 'corporate_financing' uses offset, limit, organization_ids, organizations, investor_ids, investors, funding_type_mapping_codes, date_from, date_to, field_options; 'drug_deal' uses offset, limit, drug, drug_type, target, mechanism_action, drug_disease, deal_disease, licensor, licensee, phase, deal_type, country, deal_date_from, deal_date_to, field_options; 'news' uses offset, limit, keyword, drug, target, disease, organization, drug_type, post_date_from, post_date_to, field_options; 'translational_medicine' uses offset, limit, drug, target, disease, drug_type, mechanism_action, organization, published_date_from, published_date_to, field_options. Send only the fields belonging to the selected variant.

input_fields.name: brief_title
input_fields.description: Clinical trial title or brief public title. Used for title keyword search. Example: 'A Study of Pembrolizumab in Advanced Lung Cancer'

input_fields.name: funding_type_mapping_codes
input_fields.description: Funding type codes, for example ['RZ04'] for Series A. Accepts RZ01 to RZ41 and RZ99. Multiple values default to OR; field_options can change this to AND.

input_fields.name: deal_date_from
input_fields.description: Start date for the deal date range. The input is in yyyy-MM-dd format and is converted to a millisecond timestamp during search. Example: '2023-01-01'

input_fields.name: investors
input_fields.description: Investor organization names, resolved to organization IDs before searching. Example: ['Atlas Venture']. Multiple values default to OR; field_options can change this to AND for co-investment in the same round.

input_fields.name: study_status
input_fields.description: Trial status filter for the current recruitment or execution state. Allowed values: ['not_yet_recruiting', 'recruiting', 'enrolling_by_invitation', 'active_not_recruiting', 'suspended', 'terminated', 'completed', 'withdrawn']

input_fields.name: top_k
input_fields.description: Maximum number of vector-retrieved clinical trial candidates before structured filtering. Defaults to 20.

input_fields.name: post_date_from
input_fields.description: Inclusive publication-date start. Supports YYYY-MM-DD, YYYYMMDD, or a 13-digit timestamp.

input_fields.name: limit
input_fields.description: Page size. Must be between 1 and 100.

input_fields.name: drug_disease
input_fields.description: Drug indication name list for the asset itself. Example: ['lung cancer', 'hypertension']

input_fields.name: study_first_posted_date_to
input_fields.description: End date for the first posted date. Use YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: '2024-12-31'

input_fields.name: lang
input_fields.description: Language code for vector retrieval when query is provided. Allowed values: CN or EN.

input_fields.name: keyword
input_fields.description: Full-text keyword list for news retrieval. Example: ['FDA approval', 'safety warning']

input_fields.name: study_code
input_fields.description: Study code or sponsor trial identifier. Example: 'MK-3475-01'

input_fields.name: offset
input_fields.description: Result offset, starting from 0.

input_fields.name: licensee
input_fields.description: Licensee organization name list. Example: ['Roche', 'Novartis']

input_fields.name: route_of_administration
input_fields.description: Route of administration filter. Example: ['oral', 'intravenous', 'topical']

input_fields.name: deal_type
input_fields.description: Deal type filter. Allowed values: ['collaboration', 'option', 'investment', 'asset_acquisition', 'merger_and_acquisition', 'license']

input_fields.name: query
input_fields.description: Natural-language semantic query for vector retrieval. Can be used alone or together with structured filters. Example: EGFR inhibitor phase 2 lung cancer trial

input_fields.name: licensor
input_fields.description: Licensor organization name list. Example: ['Pfizer', 'Merck']

input_fields.name: deal_disease
input_fields.description: Deal indication name list used in the transaction description or rights scope. Example: ['lung cancer', 'diabetes']

input_fields.name: date_to
input_fields.description: Announcement date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Example: '2025-12-31'

input_fields.name: organization_ids
input_fields.description: Funded company IDs, matched exactly without parent or subsidiary expansion. Multiple values default to OR; field_options can change this to AND.

input_fields.name: dosage_form
input_fields.description: Dosage form filter. Example: ['tablet', 'injection', 'capsule']

input_fields.name: deal_date_to
input_fields.description: End date for the deal date range. The input is in yyyy-MM-dd format and is converted to a millisecond timestamp during search. Example: '2024-12-31'

input_fields.name: post_date_to
input_fields.description: Inclusive publication-date end. Supports YYYY-MM-DD, YYYYMMDD, or a 13-digit timestamp.

input_fields.name: organizations
input_fields.description: Funded company names, resolved to organization IDs before searching. Example: ['HotSpot Therapeutics']. Multiple values default to OR; field_options can change this to AND.

input_fields.name: date_from
input_fields.description: Announcement date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Example: '2025-01-01'

tools.name: ls_entity_search
tools.capability: 按药物条件搜索药物、靶点、机构或疾病。
tools.description_en:
Search with drug filters and select the result entity.

Accepts all drug search filters. entity_type is required and accepts drug,
target, organization, or disease (Indication). A drug search is entity_type="drug".
org_roll_up defaults to true: group organizations by parent company; false
uses individual organizations. It only affects organization grouping and is
ignored for other dimensions.

At least one non-empty search filter is required. entity_type, org_roll_up,
offset, limit and field_options alone do not count as filters.
offset must be >= 0 and limit must be between 1 and 100; out-of-range
values are rejected before any downstream call.
field_options controls AND/OR within target, disease, organization and
drug_type values; relations between fields keep existing drug-search semantics.

Drug results return total/items/query with the drug summaries.
Group results preserve pagination: offset/limit/total/items
and any sub_offset/sub_limit/sub_total/sub_count supplied by the backend.
Group totals count groups, not drugs. Items preserve entity identifiers,
complete related ID lists/counts and dimension-specific attributes.
Entity views contain their existing ID field and Chinese/English display
names only. View arrays may contain a subset of related entities; use the
related ID lists and counts for totals and ls_entity_fetch for entity details.
Organization results use org_id/org_id_view, target results use list-valued
target_id/target_id_view, and indication results use disease_id/disease_id_view.
No extra ID-list truncation, query or reference is added to group results.
Existing backend grouping limits and errors remain in effect, including a
5000-group cap per query: results beyond 5000 groups are silently
truncated (total stops growing past 5000) with no error or flag, so a
total of exactly 5000 may mean either an exact match or a truncated set.

Few-shot examples (copyable calls; entity_type is required and picks the result entity):
    User intent: Find a specific marketed or in-development asset by drug, target, disease, company, and modality.
    ✔ ls_entity_search(entity_type="drug", drug=["pembrolizumab"], target=["PD-1"], disease=["non-small cell lung cancer"], organization=["Merck"], drug_type=["Monoclonal antibody"], limit=20)
    User intent: Find approved company-developed drugs by action, status, and geography.
    ✔ ls_entity_search(entity_type="drug", action_type=["inhibitor"], highest_phase=["approved"], dev_status=["approved"], org_type=["company"], country=["US"], limit=20)
    User intent: Find targets associated with Pfizer's matching drugs.
    ✔ ls_entity_search(entity_type="target", organization=["Pfizer"])
    User intent: List organizations developing bispecific antibodies, without parent-company aggregation.
    ✔ ls_entity_search(entity_type="organization", drug_type=["Bispecific antibody"], org_roll_up=False)
    User intent: Find indications associated with drugs matching EGFR.
    ✔ ls_entity_search(entity_type="disease", target=["EGFR"], offset=0, limit=20)
    Note: disease is the Indication result dimension. org_roll_up defaults to True and only affects organization grouping.

input_fields.name: field_options
input_fields.description: Optional field-level settings for target, disease, organization, and drug_type. Each field accepts value_operator: AND or OR.

input_fields.name: mechanism_action
input_fields.description: Mechanism of action filter used for more specific pharmacology matching. Example: ['PD-1 inhibitor', 'EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor']. Multiple values are combined with OR; AND is not supported for this field.

input_fields.name: country
input_fields.description: Country or region code list, such as the market or development geography used by the underlying query. The input must use country codes. Example: ['US', 'CN', 'EU']. Multiple values are combined with OR; AND is not supported for this field.

input_fields.name: atc_code
input_fields.description: ATC code filter for therapy-area or class-based retrieval. Example: ['A01', 'C07']. Multiple values are combined with OR; AND is not supported for this field.

input_fields.description: Global highest development status filter. Allowed values: ['discovery', 'preclinical', 'ind_application', 'ind_approval', 'clinical', 'early_phase_1', 'phase_1', 'phase_1_2', 'phase_2', 'phase_2_3', 'phase_3', 'nda_bla', 'approved', 'phase_4', 'discontinued', 'suspended', 'withdrawn', 'pending', 'unknown', 'not_applicable', 'other', 'inactive']. input_fields.description: In-development disease name list, mapped to the drug disease field used for pipeline filtering. Example: ['lung cancer', 'diabetes']

input_fields.description: Result offset, starting from 0.

input_fields.name: dev_status
input_fields.description: Current development status filter. input_fields.description: Action type filter for the high-level activity mode of the drug. Allowed values: ['agonist', 'antagonist', 'inhibitor', 'modulator']. Multiple values are combined with OR; AND is not supported for this field.

input_fields.description: Organization type filter applied to the related R&D organizations that a result is linked to, not the type of the result entity itself (see the result item's own entity_type field for that). tools.name: ls_patent_search
tools.capability: 通过语义、关键词和结构化生命科学条件搜索专利。根据 semantic_query、keywords、filters/domain_filters 自动选择检索方式；不接受 domain 或布尔检索。limit 为 1–100，offset + limit 不超过 1000。domain_filters 的字段、操作符、枚举及类型由输入 Schema 定义；每个 in/not_in 最多 100 个唯一值，总操作数不超过 256。返回 status、data.docs、data.returned_count、可选的 data.total_hits 和顶层 hints，移除文档的 domain_data；缺失 total_hits 不代表零。错误通过 MCP 错误通道返回。
tools.description_en:
Search global patents with life-sciences filters in a single call.

Supported domain_filters fields, operators, operand types and enums are
defined in the input schema. Invalid conditions are rejected before search.
LS fields include drug, target, disease and drug_type (public names);
patent_core_type and patent_technology (category values); applicant_type
(uppercase codes such as COMPANY); inchi_all/inchi_claims (numeric compound
IDs); sequence_all/sequence_claims (numeric sequence IDs). Claim fields limit
matching to claims; all fields cover general associations. Scalar conditions
use eq/ne with a scalar or in/not_in with a non-empty unique value array.
Invalid conditions fail with a field-specific error before the search request.

At least one effective search condition is required. Keywords and semantic
recall combine with OR, then filters combine with AND; semantic_query does
not narrow broad keyword matches. Retain complete concept phrases and
qualifiers. Keyword languages are Chinese, English and Japanese. Boolean
search is incompatible with the life-sciences domain.

offset + limit <= 1000. Sort supports relevance and publication/application/
granted/expired/priority/cited_count, with '-' for descending order.
collapse_family=true deduplicates documents and the available count.
Returns a success envelope: data.docs contains the documents,
data.returned_count is the number of returned documents, data.total_hits is optional,
and top-level hints may contain retrieval hints. Missing total_hits is not zero. Only document
id is guaranteed; other metadata may be omitted. domain_data is removed
from each document. No score or datasource is returned. IDs can be used with ls_patent_fetch.
Upstream HTTP and business failures use the MCP error channel.

Examples:
    ls_patent_search(semantic_query="EGFR inhibitors overcoming T790M resistance")
    ls_patent_search(domain_filters={"target": {"in": ["EGFR"]}})

Few-shot examples (copyable calls):
    User intent: Find patents on EGFR inhibitors overcoming T790M resistance.

tools.name: ls_patent_search
tools.capability: 通过语义、关键词和结构化生命科学条件搜索专利。根据 semantic_query、keywords、filters/domain_filters 自动选择检索方式；不接受 domain 或布尔检索。limit 为 1–100，offset + limit 不超过 1000。domain_filters 的字段、操作符、枚举及类型由输入 Schema 定义；每个 in/not_in 最多 100 个唯一值，总操作数不超过 256。返回 status、data.docs、data.returned_count、可选的 data.total_hits 和顶层 hints，移除文档的 domain_data；缺失 total_hits 不代表零。错误通过 MCP 错误通道返回。
tools.description_en:
Search global patents with life-sciences filters in a single call.

Supported domain_filters fields, operators, operand types and enums are
defined in the input schema. Invalid conditions are rejected before search.
LS fields include drug, target, disease and drug_type (public names);
patent_core_type and patent_technology (category values); applicant_type
(uppercase codes such as COMPANY); inchi_all/inchi_claims (numeric compound
IDs); sequence_all/sequence_claims (numeric sequence IDs). Claim fields limit
matching to claims; all fields cover general associations. Scalar conditions
use eq/ne with a scalar or in/not_in with a non-empty unique value array.
Invalid conditions fail with a field-specific error before the search request.

At least one effective search condition is required. Keywords and semantic
recall combine with OR, then filters combine with AND; semantic_query does
not narrow broad keyword matches. Retain complete concept phrases and
qualifiers. Keyword languages are Chinese, English and Japanese. Boolean
search is incompatible with the life-sciences domain.

offset + limit <= 1000. Sort supports relevance and publication/application/
granted/expired/priority/cited_count, with '-' for descending order.
collapse_family=true deduplicates documents and the available count.
Returns a success envelope: data.docs contains the documents,
data.returned_count is the number of returned documents, data.total_hits is optional,
and top-level hints may contain retrieval hints. Missing total_hits is not zero. Only document
id is guaranteed; other metadata may be omitted. domain_data is removed
from each document. No score or datasource is returned. IDs can be used with ls_patent_fetch.
Upstream HTTP and business failures use the MCP error channel.

Examples:
    ls_patent_search(semantic_query="EGFR inhibitors overcoming T790M resistance")
    ls_patent_search(domain_filters={"target": {"in": ["EGFR"]}})

Few-shot examples (copyable calls):
    User intent: Find patents on EGFR inhibitors overcoming T790M resistance.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(semantic_query="EGFR inhibitors overcoming T790M resistance")
    User intent: Search Chinese, English and Japanese keyword phrases for EGFR inhibitors.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(keywords=["EGFR inhibitor", "EGFR抑制剂", "EGFR阻害剤"], limit=20)
    User intent: Find patents associated with EGFR from company applicants.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(domain_filters={"target": {"in": ["EGFR"]}, "applicant_type": {"eq": "COMPANY"}}, limit=20)
    User intent: Return one representative patent per family for EGFR from company applicants.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(domain_filters={"target": {"in": ["EGFR"]}, "applicant_type": {"eq": "COMPANY"}}, collapse_family=True, limit=20)
    User intent: Find US patents using EGFR inhibitor keywords and an EGFR target filter.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(keywords=["EGFR inhibitor"], filters={"jurisdiction": ["US"]}, domain_filters={"target": {"eq": "EGFR"}}, limit=20)
    User intent: Filter by both the known internal compound ID 4401484 and claimed-sequence ID 2205.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(domain_filters={"inchi_all": {"eq": 4401484}, "sequence_claims": {"in": [2205]}}, limit=20)
    Note: compound and sequence values are internal integer IDs supplied by the search context, not names or sequence text. Both fields in the last example are required by that intent and combine with AND.

tools.name: ls_patent_search
tools.capability: 通过语义、关键词和结构化生命科学条件搜索专利。根据 semantic_query、keywords、filters/domain_filters 自动选择检索方式；不接受 domain 或布尔检索。limit 为 1–100，offset + limit 不超过 1000。domain_filters 的字段、操作符、枚举及类型由输入 Schema 定义；每个 in/not_in 最多 100 个唯一值，总操作数不超过 256。返回 status、data.docs、data.returned_count、可选的 data.total_hits 和顶层 hints，移除文档的 domain_data；缺失 total_hits 不代表零。错误通过 MCP 错误通道返回。
tools.description_en:
Search global patents with life-sciences filters in a single call.

Supported domain_filters fields, operators, operand types and enums are
defined in the input schema. Invalid conditions are rejected before search.
LS fields include drug, target, disease and drug_type (public names);
patent_core_type and patent_technology (category values); applicant_type
(uppercase codes such as COMPANY); inchi_all/inchi_claims (numeric compound
IDs); sequence_all/sequence_claims (numeric sequence IDs). Claim fields limit
matching to claims; all fields cover general associations. Scalar conditions
use eq/ne with a scalar or in/not_in with a non-empty unique value array.
Invalid conditions fail with a field-specific error before the search request.

At least one effective search condition is required. Keywords and semantic
recall combine with OR, then filters combine with AND; semantic_query does
not narrow broad keyword matches. Retain complete concept phrases and
qualifiers. Keyword languages are Chinese, English and Japanese. Boolean
search is incompatible with the life-sciences domain.

offset + limit <= 1000. Sort supports relevance and publication/application/
granted/expired/priority/cited_count, with '-' for descending order.
collapse_family=true deduplicates documents and the available count.
Returns a success envelope: data.docs contains the documents,
data.returned_count is the number of returned documents, data.total_hits is optional,
and top-level hints may contain retrieval hints. Missing total_hits is not zero. Only document
id is guaranteed; other metadata may be omitted. domain_data is removed
from each document. No score or datasource is returned. IDs can be used with ls_patent_fetch.
Upstream HTTP and business failures use the MCP error channel.

Examples:
    ls_patent_search(semantic_query="EGFR inhibitors overcoming T790M resistance")
    ls_patent_search(domain_filters={"target": {"in": ["EGFR"]}})

Few-shot examples (copyable calls):
    User intent: Find patents on EGFR inhibitors overcoming T790M resistance.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(semantic_query="EGFR inhibitors overcoming T790M resistance")
    User intent: Search Chinese, English and Japanese keyword phrases for EGFR inhibitors.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(keywords=["EGFR inhibitor", "EGFR抑制剂", "EGFR阻害剤"], limit=20)
    User intent: Find patents associated with EGFR from company applicants.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(domain_filters={"target": {"in": ["EGFR"]}, "applicant_type": {"eq": "COMPANY"}}, limit=20)
    User intent: Return one representative patent per family for EGFR from company applicants.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(domain_filters={"target": {"in": ["EGFR"]}, "applicant_type": {"eq": "COMPANY"}}, collapse_family=True, limit=20)
    User intent: Find US patents using EGFR inhibitor keywords and an EGFR target filter.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(keywords=["EGFR inhibitor"], filters={"jurisdiction": ["US"]}, domain_filters={"target": {"eq": "EGFR"}}, limit=20)
    User intent: Filter by both the known internal compound ID 4401484 and claimed-sequence ID 2205.
    ✔ ls_patent_search(domain_filters={"inchi_all": {"eq": 4401484}, "sequence_claims": {"in": [2205]}}, limit=20)
    Note: compound and sequence values are internal integer IDs supplied by the search context, not names or sequence text. Both fields in the last example are required by that intent and combine with AND.

tools.name: ls_sequence_search
tools.capability: 统一序列与修饰条件检索入口，支持等待、续查和分页。search.search_type 默认为 SEQUENCE，须提供 sequence_type、query_type、sequence；MODIFICATION 模式须提供 sequence_type、database、modification_location，sequence 可选。search 与 job_id 必须且只能提供一个；续查或翻页仅传 job_id 和结果选项，无需重传检索模式。相似度和覆盖度过滤使用 0–100 百分数。通过原生 MCP tools/call 调用，支持 progressToken；无独立 REST 路由。
tools.description_en:
Search, resume and paginate sequences.

Set search.search_type to SEQUENCE (default when omitted) for a sequence
query, or MODIFICATION for modification conditions. SEQUENCE requires
sequence_type, query_type and sequence. MODIFICATION requires
sequence_type, database and modification_location; sequence is optional.
Do not mix parameters from the two modes. Resume either mode with job_id
only, without search or search_type.

Supply exactly one of search or job_id. Use search for a new query;
use the returned job_id with this same tool for pending jobs or additional
pages, omitting search. Existing jobs are never resubmitted: wait if still
running, then fetch the requested page. Use pagination.next_offset as
result_options.offset, and resend the same sorting/filter options on each
page. No legacy tools are required. MCP progress requires progressToken
and reports stages, not percentages. search.limit caps search hits;
result_options.limit controls page size (1-100). Search and result
identity/coverage filters both use percentages from 0 to 100 (80 means
80%). For sorting, e.g. use perc_identity.

apis.name: 外观防侵权检索-提交工作流任务
apis.nav_name: [AI39-1] 外观防侵权检索-提交工作流任务
apis.summary: AI39-1 Design Patent Infringement Search - Submit Workflow Task
apis.description:
Submit images and create an asynchronous search task. Provide single-image url/target_image_base64 or an image_urls/image_base64s list. Do not mix the two modes or supply both lists. URL takes precedence when both single-image fields are supplied.

For multiple images, recognize main/auxiliary views before optional LOC prediction. Manual loc_items take priority. Automatic LOC runs only when auto_loc_enabled=true, description is nonblank and manual LOC is empty. Preprocessing increases submit latency. After receiving task_id, use the existing status and stage-result APIs; the remaining workflow runs automatically.

On automatic LOC failure or no result, continue with other filters and no automatic LOC restriction; check preprocessing.auto_loc.status. If all multi-view recognition attempts fail, use only the first image. Validation failures do not create a task; other submission failures do not guarantee that no task record exists.

Request (single URL, manual LOC):
```json
{
  "url": "https://static-open.zhihuiya.com/sample/common_demo.png",
  "description": "目标产品描述",
  "lang": "cn",
  "country": [
    "CN",
    "EU"
  ],
  "loc_items": [
    {
      "id": "14-03",
      "desc": "电信设备、无线遥控设备和无线电放大器"
    }
  ],
  "apply_start_time": "20200101",
  "apply_end_time": "20260917",
  "simple_legal_status": "1,2",
  "auto_loc_enabled": false
}
```

Request (single Base64):
```json
{
  "target_image_base64": "<BASE64_ENCODED_IMAGE>",
  "description": "目标产品描述",
  "lang": "cn"
}
```

Request (automatic LOC, no manual LOC):
```json
{
  "url": "https://static-open.zhihuiya.com/sample/common_demo.png",
  "description": "目标产品描述",
  "auto_loc_enabled": true
}
```

Request (multiple URLs, automatic LOC):
```json
{
```

apis.summary: AI62-1 PDF Translation - Submit Translation Task
apis.description:
Upload a PDF file using pdf, or supply a PDF download URL using pdf_url, including a signed URL. Provide exactly one. Set output_format=pdf for a layout-preserving translated PDF (default), or output_format=markdown for a Markdown text file (.md). Accepted tasks return HTTP 202. Poll status_url; once state is succeeded, call the result endpoint in download_file to retrieve the translation in the selected format.

Request example (file upload, multipart/form-data):
```bash
curl -X POST 'http://s-patsnaprd-pdf-translation-api.patsnaprd/translate' \
  -H 'accept: application/json' \
  -F 'pdf=@/path/to/sample.pdf;type=application/pdf' \
  -F 'source_lang=zh' \
  -F 'target_lang=en' \
  -F 'pages=1' \
  -F 'model_id=9' \
  -F 'output_format=pdf'
```

Request example (PDF URL, multipart/form-data):
```bash
curl -X POST 'http://s-patsnaprd-pdf-translation-api.patsnaprd/translate' \
  -H 'accept: application/json' \
  -F 'pdf_url=https://storage.example.com/sample.pdf?signature=EXAMPLE' \
  -F 'source_lang=zh' \
  -F 'target_lang=en' \
  -F 'pages=1' \
  -F 'model_id=9' \
  -F 'output_format=pdf'
```

For Markdown output, set output_format=markdown. Omit pages to translate all pages. Omit pdf when using pdf_url. With -F, curl automatically generates the multipart/form-data Content-Type header with its boundary; no manual Content-Type header is needed.

Success response example (HTTP 202):
```json

  "task_id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",

    1
  ],

  "message": "任务已提交。请轮询 status_url，成功后访问 download_file 获取结果：PDF。"
}
```

Request parameters (multipart/form-data):

| Parameter | Type | Required | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| pdf | file / string | No; exactly one of pdf / pdf_url | sample.pdf |
| pdf_url | string | No; exactly one of pdf_url / pdf | https://storage.example.com/sample.pdf?signature=EXAMPLE |
| source_lang | string | No; explicitly supply it | zh |
| target_lang | string | No; explicitly supply it | en |
| pages | string | No; omitted means all pages | 1 |
| model_id | string | No; server default is 9 | 9 |
| output_format | string | No; server default is pdf | pdf |

Upload with -F 'pdf=@/path/to/sample.pdf;type=application/pdf', or pass a URL with -F 'pdf=https://storage.example.com/sample.pdf?signature=EXAMPLE'. OpenAPI 3.0 declares file uploads as string/binary; use pdf_url for URL input. apis.name: PDF 翻译-获取翻译结果
apis.nav_name: [AI62-3] PDF 翻译-获取翻译结果
apis.summary: AI62-3 PDF Translation - Get Translation Result
apis.description:
Returns HTTP 202 while the task is processing. Pass response_format=url to receive SignedResultResponse JSON once complete; download_file contains the signed download URL for the result file. A PDF or Markdown signed URL is valid for one week (7 days, 604800 seconds) from issuance. Download the PDF or Markdown file before the expiration time in expires_at. Pass response_format=file to download the result file directly, with Content-Type application/pdf for PDF or text/markdown for Markdown. For a fully successful task with empty failed_pages, the first result retrieval is metered by selected_page_count, which equals total_pages when pages is empty or omitted. Signed-URL retrieval and direct file download share one billing event. Repeated retrievals and results containing failed or degraded pages return 0.

Request example (signed download URL, no request body):
```bash
curl -X GET 'http://s-patsnaprd-pdf-translation-api.patsnaprd/tasks/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef/result?response_format=url' \
  -H 'accept: application/json'
```

Direct file download example:
```bash
curl -X GET 'http://s-patsnaprd-pdf-translation-api.patsnaprd/tasks/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef/result?response_format=file' \
  -H 'accept: */*'
```

Success response example (HTTP 200):
```json
{
  "task_id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
  "state": "succeeded",
  "download_file": "https://storage.example.com/sample.translated.pdf?signature=EXAMPLE",
  "expires_in": 604800,
  "expires_at": "2026-10-27T10:00:00Z",
  "filename": "sample.translated.pdf",
  "media_type": "application/pdf"
}
```

Signed URL response example for a Markdown task:
```json
{
  "task_id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
  "state": "succeeded",
  "download_file": "https://storage.example.com/sample.translated.md?signature=EXAMPLE",
  "expires_in": 604800,
  "expires_at": "2026-10-27T10:00:00Z",
  "filename": "sample.translated.md",
  "media_type": "text/markdown"
}
```

request_fields.name: response_format
request_fields.description: Result response format. url returns JSON containing the signed download URL in download_file; PDF or Markdown URLs are valid for one week (7 days, 604800 seconds). file returns the result file directly. Explicitly pass url to retrieve a signed download URL. Example: "url" When omitted, the service uses its configured default; the example url is not a server-side default.

response_fields.name: expires_at
response_fields.description: Signed URL expiration time in ISO 8601 format; for PDF or Markdown results, the issuance time plus one week (7 days). Example: "2026-10-27T10:00:00Z"

response_fields.name: expires_in
response_fields.description: Signed URL lifetime in seconds. PDF or Markdown result URLs are valid for one week (7 days), represented by 604800. Example: 604800

response_fields.name: download_file
response_fields.description: Signed download URL for the result file, not the task result endpoint. A PDF or Markdown signed URL is valid for one week (7 days, 604800 seconds) from issuance; download the file before expires_at. Example: "https://storage.example.com/sample.translated.pdf?signature=EXAMPLE"

apis.name: DOCX翻译
apis.description: The public REST endpoint accepts DOCX Base64 in JSON only and supports zh→en only. Review always runs; enable_revision controls only whether the single final DOCX shows this review’s tracked changes and comments. At completion, the download fields cover the final DOCX, comparison HTML, complete revision.json, and provenance JSON; with provenance off, the first three types remain.

request_fields.name: file_content_base64
request_fields.description: Required. Base64 DOCX bytes without a data: prefix.

request_fields.name: filename
request_fields.description: Original DOCX filename ending with `.docx` (1-255 characters). Defaults to `document.docx` when omitted. Example: `patent_translation.docx`.

request_fields.name: sourceLanguageCode
request_fields.description: Source language: zh only.

request_fields.name: targetLanguageCode
request_fields.description: Target language: en only.

request_fields.name: enable_async
request_fields.description: `false` (default): run to completion in this request and bill once. `true`: return `job_id` immediately (not billed) and query later via `POST /docx-translation/api/v1/jobs/status`.

request_fields.name: user_id
request_fields.description: Optional business identity used to load the user’s saved global glossary. Never inferred from X-User-Id. Omit to skip user global glossary loading. Trimmed value must be nonempty and contain no control characters; maximum length is deployment-configured.

request_fields.description: Optional zh2en task glossary; task terms override the user glossary.

request_fields.name: enable_revision
request_fields.description: Review always runs. true: show this review’s tracked changes and comments in the final DOCX; false: deliver the clean document with validated edits applied; null/omitted: use the deployment display default. Legacy auto_revision is accepted, but do not send both names.

request_fields.description: Enable patent terminology provenance. Omitted/null follows deployment defaults; false disables it for this job; true requires deployment-level enablement. Results are returned in provenance.

request_fields.description: Optional provenance intensity: fast, standard, full (default); ignored when provenance is disabled.

response_fields.name: error
response_fields.description: Exception string when `failed`; `null` for `queued` / `working` / `ready` / `delivered`. Example: `null` (not failed) or `"upstream translation call failed after retries"` (failed).

response_fields.name: status
response_fields.description: Job status: `queued` accepted / `working` in progress / `ready` first completed result (billed) / `delivered` later lookup (not billed, still downloadable) / `failed` (see `error`). A synchronous submit always returns `ready`/`failed` (it is marked `billed` immediately and is never remapped to `delivered`). response_fields.description: Customer glossary summary used by this job; null when no glossary was provided.

response_fields.name: job_type
response_fields.description: Job type; translation for this submission endpoint.

response_fields.description: Progress as `current/100` percent string. Updates during `queued`/`working`; `ready`/`delivered` → `100/100`; `failed` → `0/100`.

response_fields.description: Complete review result object. Every successful translation runs review; this may be null before completion. review_complete=false indicates unresolved items and does not change the uniform 1x character price.

response_fields.name: direction
response_fields.description: Public REST translation direction is zh-en.

response_fields.description: Patent terminology provenance result; null when disabled or unavailable.

response_fields.name: auto_revision
response_fields.description: Legacy field indicating whether this review’s marks appear in the final DOCX; it does not control review execution.

response_fields.name: billable_chars
response_fields.description: Billable character count, retained on ready/delivered. The minimum charge can raise very short inputs above source_chars.

response_fields.description: Million-character-equivalent usage reported to the REST gateway for this response, not CNY. Nonzero on the first ready response; 0.000000 on delivered/failure/pending responses without erasing the order price.

response_fields.description: Filename of the same final reviewed DOCX in internal Base64 output mode, not a separate unreviewed translation artifact.

response_fields.name: provenance_mode
response_fields.description: Provenance search intensity: fast prioritizes latency, standard balances latency and recall, full prioritizes recall (default). Has no effect when provenance is disabled.

response_fields.name: review_executed
response_fields.description: Whether this job has executed review; may be false before completion.

response_fields.name: review_required
response_fields.description: Review is mandatory for translation jobs and this is true.

response_fields.name: output_size_bytes
response_fields.description: Byte size of the same final reviewed DOCX in internal Base64 output mode.

response_fields.description: Signed URL for revision.json, matching the complete revision response object. With object storage enabled, it and the final DOCX are required publications; upload failure prevents ready. Empty when storage is disabled or the job is unfinished.

apis.description:
Input a patent number to automatically complete TS recommendation, section recall, and Claim Chart (CC) comparison, receiving SEP determination results via Server-Sent Events.

Each SSE event is a data: line containing a JSON object. Events fall into two categories:

  • PROCESSING — heartbeat/progress update, no business payload
  • FINISH — final result with content populated (SEP determination conclusion)

Flow when ts is provided (skip TS recommendation): INIT → FIND_SECTIONS → CC_COMPARE

Flow when ts is omitted (auto-recommend TS): INIT → RECOMMEND_TS → FIND_SECTIONS → CC_COMPARE

Stemming ON will search for the original word and expand the search to consider singular, plural, and tense variations e.g. a search for "come" will expand to "comes", "came", "coming" and so on.

apis.name: 专利/论文智能检索
apis.description: Intelligent hybrid search for patents and academic papers. Supports free combination of three retrieval strategies: semantic search, keyword search, and structured filtering. Each request targets a single data source (patent or paper), returning documents sorted by relevance with pagination support.

request_fields.name: search_strategy
request_fields.description:
Retrieval strategy combination. Allowed values: 'semantic', 'keyword', 'filter'.
Strategy-param binding is STRICT:
- 'semantic' in strategy → MUST provide semantic_query
- 'keyword' in strategy → MUST provide keywords
- 'filter' in strategy → MUST provide filters (≥1 field set)
Default: ['keyword']

request_fields.name: semantic_query
request_fields.description: A complete natural-language description of the technical problem or concept. MUST be a full sentence, never a keyword list. Required only when 'semantic' ∈ search_strategy.

request_fields.name: keywords
request_fields.description: Keyword list for BM25 text matching. Recommended 3-8 independent technical terms. Required only when 'keyword' ∈ search_strategy. Do NOT pass 15+ keywords.

request_fields.name: source
request_fields.description: Data source selection (required, single value). Allowed: 'patent' (global patent data) or 'paper' (academic papers). Each request targets exactly one source; issue two calls to cover both.

request_fields.name: limit
request_fields.description: Page size — number of results per page. Range: 1-100. Default: 10. Use with offset for pagination. Constraint: offset + limit ≤ 1000.

request_fields.name: offset
request_fields.description: Pagination offset — number of leading results to skip. Default: 0. Constraint: offset + limit ≤ 1000 (Vespa pagination depth limit).

response_fields.description: Error message, only present when status=error

request_fields.name: stemming
request_fields.description:
Whether to turn on the stemming function, 1: turn on; 0: turn off. Off by default

Note:

Stemming ON will search for the original word and expand the search to consider singular, plural, and tense variations e.g. a search for "come" will expand to "comes", "came", "coming" and so on.

Stemming OFF will only search for exact matches of the keywords entered.

The use of wildcards in keywords within a search query will impact the effect of stemming.

Stemming ON only supports English words. Stemming does not apply to Assignees, Inventors, or any other person-related fields.

request_fields.name: limit
request_fields.description: Returns the number of statistical results, 1 <= limit <= 100，default is 50

request_fields.name: stemming
request_fields.description:
Whether to turn on the stemming function, 1: turn on; 0: turn off. Off by default

Note:

Stemming ON will search for the original word and expand the search to consider singular, plural, and tense variations e.g. a search for "come" will expand to "comes", "came", "coming" and so on.

Stemming OFF will only search for exact matches of the keywords entered.

The use of wildcards in keywords within a search query will impact the effect of stemming.

Stemming ON only supports English words. Stemming does not apply to Assignees, Inventors, or any other person-related fields.

apis.name: 创建专利申请前评估报告
apis.summary: R003 Create Pre-patent Evaluation Report Task
apis.description: Input the technical description text of the patent to be applied for (more than 200 words recommended), create the task of pre-patent evaluation report generation, and return the job id of the report export; The report contains scores and detailed index results for the three dimensions of technological innovation, patentability and translation prospect of the technology solution.

request_fields.name: text
request_fields.description: Technical description text (more than 200 words recommended)

request_fields.name: limit
request_fields.description: Number of similar patents used for model calculation, 0< limit≤100, default is 50

request_fields.name: tech_maturity_index
request_fields.description:
Patent technology maturity:
1: Report level (the basic principle of the technology has been observed and reported, which is in the research stage of paper theory)
2: Solution level (propose problems and corresponding solutions based on the discovered principles)
3: Functional level (proof of concept completed through theoretical and experimental analysis of key functions or features)
4: Simulation level (completed the verification of components and experimental samples in the laboratory environment, and carried out the integration of basic components)
5: Initial sample level (completed the verification of components and samples under simulated application conditions)
6: Positive sample level (completed the verification of components and experimental samples under approximate application conditions)
7: Environment level (completed the demonstration of the technology in the real application environment)
8: Product level (completed the product finalization, with the ability of large-scale production)
9: System level (completed the validation of the technology's products and other related product combinations)
10: Industrial level (the technology develops into an industry with mature supporting processes, components and products to implement the technology)

request_fields.name: report_name
request_fields.description: Report name

request_fields.name: report_info
request_fields.description: Report basic information (for report presentation)

api_mapping.method: 分层证据判定：人工确认 > 官方描述模板 > 双向唯一入参签名 > 仅候选 > 工作流不可推断
api_mapping.important_limit: 官方 MCP 页面不提供 tool 输出字段，因此无法用响应参数做映射；且数据字典类 tool 共用同一组入参，纯参数匹配会产生大量假阳性。

confidence_legend.high: 官方 tool 描述模板唯一对应某个 API 中文名
confidence_legend.medium: 入参名集合在 tool 与 API 两侧双向唯一且一致
confidence_legend.low: 沿用上一版人工标注，本轮未获证据支持

covers_scenarios: 法律状态/年费/诉讼监测
starter_kits.note: 不要一上来装专利域全部 23 个 MCP。全景分析、价值评估、撰写、SEP 对照等都属高阶，按具体任务再叠加。

minimal.why: 一个 MCP 覆盖全球专利检索、著录项目、权利要求、说明书、附图、同族与引用，是专利场景的最小可用闭环。

standard.why: 在检索之上补法律状态/年费/诉讼监测，以及 FTO/查新检索入口，覆盖专利日常工作约 80% 的需求。

starter_kits.name: 医药 / 生命科学情报
starter_kits.who: 药企 BD、研发立项、临床与注册、医药投资分析
covers_scenarios: 行业动态 / 竞情监测
starter_kits.note: ★ 这是全库上下文成本最悬殊的一个域：若只做单一细分（如只查临床、只查靶点），优先按场景表装 1 个小 MCP，别装主干。需要跨十几类数据联动时才上 pharma-intelligence。

minimal.why: 只查药物管线与临床试验时，两个小而专的 MCP 就够。★ 医药主干 pharma-intelligence 单个约 2.7 万 token，是本档的十几倍，轻量用户不要装。

standard.why: 一个综合终端已聚合临床、药物、靶点、疾病、生物序列、交易、FDA、流行病学、指南、财报、新闻、转化医学等十余类数据，可替代几乎全部细分 MCP；代价是工具定义较重。

starter_kits.name: 企业 / 投资尽调
starter_kits.who: 投资机构、券商研究、企业战略、供应链风控、科创板评估
starter_kits.note: company-profile 与 company-credit 在企业工商维度有重叠，除非需要更细的信用档案，否则不要同时装。

minimal.why: 企业科技 360 档案一个 MCP 即覆盖工商、资质、团队、投融资、专利与科技画像，适合快速核验主体。

standard.why: 补上科创投资尽调与风险预警，形成『核验 → 评估 → 预警』闭环。

starter_kits.name: 材料 / 配方研发
starter_kits.who: 材料研发工程师、日化配方、高分子与金属工艺、化妆品法规
covers_scenarios: 材料配方 / 性能检索
starter_kits.note: 材料域目前仅 2 个原生 MCP，是五个域里最轻的。化学分子相关 MCP 按官方分类归在医药情报，此处按用途跨域引用。

minimal.why: 材料搜索（金属、高分子配方、化妆品等）是材料域的最小可用入口，只有 2 个工具。

standard.why: 补化学分子结构/ADMET 与化妆品法规合规查询，覆盖配方研发到合规的主要链路。

starter_kits.name: 研发 / 创新工程师
starter_kits.who: 企业研发、技术预研、创新方法推进、科技情报
covers_scenarios: 产学研合作 / 专家寻找
starter_kits.note: 若只查科研文献，可把 minimal 降级为 literature-search（约 480 token，比融合检索轻 6 倍）。

minimal.why: 专利 + 文献融合检索一个入口即可起步，避免同时装专利库和文献库两个 MCP。

standard.why: 在融合检索之上补 TRIZ 创新方案生成与报告生成，形成『检索 → 解题 → 输出』链路。
